# Changelog

Notable changes per release, following [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/). Versions follow the milestones in `docs/Design Document.md`.

## [Unreleased]

## [0.0.1] - 2026-11-24
### Added
- Laravel 13, Inertia, React and TypeScript, from the official starter kit
- ULID primary keys
- PostgreSQL 17 and Mailpit through Docker Compose
- CI: formatting, lint, types, Vitest and Pest on Postgres
- Accounts with username and bio, email verification, password reset and two-factor authentication
- Header layout with guest navigation, and a Voxtopia landing page
